**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **Section 14.3 (p0668/p0671)** is the only liquidated damages clause, and it runs *against Array*: on the specified Array failures, Ono may elect to continue the Agreement, be relieved of diligence obligations, and take a reduced royalty rate "as liquidated damages." That is a Vendor-payable remedy in our favour, so per the detection guidance it is not flagged.
- **Section 13.2 (p0628)** lets Ono terminate without cause on notice with no exit fee, minimum payment or accelerated royalties; Article XIV imposes wind-down cost allocations but no liquidated sum.
- **Article VI/VII** contains only ordinary upfront, milestone and royalty consideration; the Section 7.1 Libor late-payment interest (p0463) is compensatory interest, not a penalty. No occurrence of "penalty" anywhere in the document.
- **Section 8.2** post-termination Competing Product standstill is a non-compete restriction, not a Customer-payable liquidated amount — left to the exclusivity rule to avoid double-flagging.
